ETH.note: Document states nothing on authentication services.
Document states nothing on a civil register to ID link.
Civil-servant digital skills appear only as an aim of the strategy, not a programme delivered.
Document names no finance, tax or payroll system.

facts.fact: DT Global, EU-funded adviser, says it has submitted the technical design of the EthioConnect national data exchange platform and is preparing priority datasets for its pilot project, with procurement still to come.

ETH.note: Skills for the general population appear only as an aim of the strategy.

systems.system: Digital Government and Enterprise Architecture Strategy 2024-2029

ETH.note: Strategy is described as a state-administration strategy; document does not say it was adopted, and gives no body or domestic budget line (about EUR 100m needed, funding unsecured).
No service stated as online; e-services are an aim.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs the ID system.
Registries named only as an access aim; no register keyed on the ID number stated.
Digital ID card mentioned only in passing as a registry to access; nothing on its status.

facts.fact: DT Global says it is drafting several technical standards documents for Ethiopia, based on the Greek government enterprise architecture, to assist procurement and implementation of the EthioConnect data exchange platform.

ETH.note: Land registry named only as an access aim.
Strategy built after a year-long stakeholder consultation, but the document does not say who outside government took part.
